subject: Stage gate: timing and documentation priorities for inference release
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Stage gate: timing and documentation priorities for inference release

Hi all,

We need to lock the stage-gate date for the next inference runtime release and finalize who owns the core deliverables for enablement. Current target from product is end of June but there are a few outstanding questions that could shift that by 1-2 weeks.

Quick asks:
- Can each of you confirm doc ownership for the listed artifacts below?
  - Public quickstart & breaking-change notes (KB)
  - Internal runbook / operator playbook
  - Sales/CS enablement one-pager + training slots
  - Migration checklist for Dedicated/Private customers
- Any hard blockers that would make the June 30 target impossible?
- If we need a stage-gate postponement, what is the minimal extra time and why?

I attached the latest stage_gate_matrix_v1.xlsx that maps dependencies. Please reply with owners and one-sentence risk notes by EOD today so I can update the gate doc before Friday's leadership review.

Thanks,
Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Sr PM, Product Launches
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 May 2025 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stage gate: timing and documentation priorities for inference release

Evelyn — thanks for the matrix. High level: June 30 is feasible but tight unless we accept scoped rollouts and prioritize customer-facing docs first. Notes and proposed owners below.

Owners (proposed):
- KB / public quickstart & breaking-change notes: Laura Bennett (I will review)
- Internal runbook / operator playbook: Ben Carter
- Sales/CS one-pager + enablement training: Marissa Cole (I'll coordinate slots with CS)
- Migration checklist (Dedicated/Private): Aditya Rao (tech details)

Enablement cadence:
- Week of 6/9: draft artifacts completed
- Week of 6/16: reviews & recorded training sessions
- Week of 6/23: docs locked, dry-run on staging with CS team

Top risks:
1) API surface changes from infra branch INF-4521 could require doc rewrites (impact: 3–7 days).
2) QA bandwidth for migration checklist validation (impact: depends on testing window).

Attachments: enablement_schedule_draft.pdf (scheduling suggestions).

If we do a phased rollout (hosted -> dedicated -> private), we can meet June 30 for hosted but may need an extra 10 business days for Private validation. Recommend we set a gating flag in the stage matrix to allow partial go-live.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Developer Enablement
Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 May 2025 16:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stage gate: timing and documentation priorities for inference release

Picking up Marissa's note — a couple technical clarifications and a short canary idea.

- Canary windows: we can run a 72-hour canary for hosted traffic (10% slice) starting 6/24 if we freeze artifacts by 6/19. That buys us observable surface for regressions.
- Fallback policy: if latency or OOM regressions exceed thresholds, automated rollback to last-compatible model build + routing to fallback region (details in INF-4521).
- Private validation: requires one full customer migration test (we can schedule Atlas Health for week of 6/30) — add ~7 business days for remediation after test.

Minor ask: Ben, will you be able to finalize the operator playbook by 6/16? If not, propose a preliminary version by 6/9 that we can iterate on after the canary.

I've attached a short draft: canary-fallback-plan.md.

Thanks — Aditya
Aditya Rao
Staff SRE, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 May 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stage gate: timing and documentation priorities for inference release

Thanks all — based on the replies I'm updating the stage gate: final decision below.

Decisions (locked):
- Target: partial go-live (hosted) on 2025-06-30. Dedicated/Private will follow in a phased schedule; Private target pushed to week of 7/14 pending Atlas migration test.
- Owners confirmed: Laura (KB), Ben (runbook), Marissa (enablement), Aditya (migration checklist & private validation).
- Canary: 6/24–6/27 (10% hosted traffic). Artifacts must be frozen by 6/19.
- Contingency: if INF-4521 lands late and causes doc churn, request escalation to product infra for priority review — estimated delay 3–7 days.

Follow-ups for owners:
- Laura: share public quickstart draft by 6/12.
- Ben: preliminary runbook by 6/9, final by 6/16.
- Marissa: book two 60-min enablement sessions (one for CS, one for sales) week of 6/16.
- Aditya: confirm Atlas test slot and share expected remediation window by EOD Friday.

Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-stage-gate-docs — I'll attach the updated matrix after I incorporate your timelines. JIRA: INF-4521 for infra changes.

If anyone cannot meet their commitments, reply with the specific blocker and the minimum slip required. Otherwise I'll present this to the leadership review on Friday.

Evelyn
Sr PM, Product Launches
Redwood Inference
